text: キクコの　ゴーストポケモンは　おそろしく　つよいぜ…！

structure.jp: キクコの　ゴーストポケモンは
おそろしく　つよいぜ…！

patterns.name: 〜く (adverb)
patterns.span: おそろしく　つよい
patterns.explanation: Changing い to く turns a describing word into one that tells how much or in what way. おそろしく　つよい = 'terrifyingly strong'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, casual male speech that adds punch to what is said. つよいぜ = 'they're strong, man'.
